facts.value: The University Computing Center (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: The telephone hotline of Goethe University assists with questions regarding applications, semester dates, re-registration, changing subjects, dual studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: International Student Services provide information on topics such as residence permits, German courses, financing, studying successfully, careers, and more. They also offer advice and support.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: The Student Union supports students in social and economic matters, ensuring students have the necessary infrastructure to study successfully in areas such as educational support, student housing, cafeterias, and advisory services.
